name: plot_scale
expr: loglog(x, y); semilogx(x, y); semilogy(x, y); r1 = 1;
comment: Sig: graphics primitives — log-scale axis variants of plot. loglog (both x and y log), semilogx (x log only), semilogy (y log only). Side-effect (emits __FIGURE_DATA__ JSON with xscale/yscale set); spec verifies the call runs without erroring. Same pattern as `plot` spec — numkit graphics handles aren't directly comparable to MATLAB.
